name: Context-use Memory
description: Uses Context-use as OpenClaw's durable memory and curates relevant chat facts and assets through a same-model subagent.

captureEnabled.label: Automatic Capture
captureEnabled.help: Run the Context-use curator after successful conversational turns.

ownerOnly.label: Owner Only
ownerOnly.help: Skip inbound messages that OpenClaw identifies as coming from a non-owner.

timeoutMs.label: Curator Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Maximum time to wait for the same-provider curator subagent.

allowedUploadOrigins.label: Context-use Upload Origins
allowedUploadOrigins.help: Exact HTTPS origins accepted by the attachment upload bridge.
